name: Ace SRV
summary: Bridge your Pumpkin server and Discord: two-way chat, join and death embeds, a console channel and account linking.
description:
## Your server, in your Discord

Ace SRV is a translation of **DiscordSRV** for Pumpkin. It connects one Discord bot to your server and keeps both sides talking.

- **Two-way chat** with role colours, role aliases, replies, mentions, custom emotes and clickable attachments
- **Announcements** for joins, first joins, leaves, deaths and advancements, as embeds or as webhooks with each player's head
- **Start and stop messages**, live channel topics and a rotating bot status
- **Console channel**: run console commands from Discord and watch chat, joins and commands mirrored back
- **`!c <command>`** for chosen roles, a `playerlist` reply that cleans itself up, and canned answers like `!ip`
- **Account linking**: `/discord link` gives a 4-digit code to DM the bot, with a *Linked* role and link/unlink commands

## Setup

1. Create a bot in the Discord developer portal and enable the **Message Content** intent.
2. Drop the `.wasm` into `plugins/`, start the server and approve its permissions in the console.
3. Keep the token out of plugin files by putting it in `pumpkin.toml`:

```toml
[plugins.overrides."ace-srv".environment]
ACE_SRV_BOT_TOKEN = "your-bot-token"
```

4. Set `channels.global` in `plugins/data/ace-srv/config.toml` and run `/discord reload`.

## Commands

| Command | Who |
| --- | --- |
| `/discord` | everyone |
| `/discord link` · `unlink` · `linked` | everyone |
| `/discord reload` · `broadcast <message>` | op level 2 |

## Not ported (yet)

Raw console log streaming (Pumpkin plugins can't read the log), group ↔ role sync, the voice module, the watchdog and hooks into Bukkit-only plugins.

permissions.why: Writes its config, messages, linked accounts and the console usage log in its own data folder.
Reads those same files back on start and on /discord reload.
Talks to the Discord REST API: sends messages, embeds, webhooks, reactions and topic updates.
Looks up Discord's gateway host name.
Holds one TLS WebSocket to the Discord gateway to receive messages in real time.

mapping.note: Non-blocking listener; cancelled chat is never relayed.
Death message rendered from its text component.
Only advancements that announce to chat.
One task drives the whole bridge.
Missing keys fall back to defaults.
Pumpkin plugins can't read the server log.
Pumpkin has no permission groups yet.

versions.changelog: - First Pumpkin release: two-way chat, event embeds, webhooks, console channel, `!c`, player list, canned replies, presence, topics and account linking
